params.name: formula
params.description: Formula object, or name of a project method, to execute in the context of subformObject

params.name: return
params.description: Variable receiving the value returned by formula

overloads.semanticRole: Executes formula in the context of subformObject and captures its returned value into 'return'.

params.name: formula
params.description: Formula object, or name of a project method, to execute in the context of subformObject
Indicates formula does not return a value

overloads.semanticRole: Executes formula in the context of subformObject, explicitly discarding any return value.

constraints: Must be called in the context of the parent form containing subformObject (e.g. from the parent form's form method).
Does nothing if subformObject is not found on the current page or is not yet instantiated.
If the subform belongs to a component, the called method/function must be marked 'Shared by components and host database'.
The execution context is preserved in the called code: the current form and form event remain defined.
